product.title: Melbourne Sports Experience + MCG Tour Combo

description.text: In Melbourne, this half-day sports walk meets at Federation Square, follows Birrarung Marr to Rod Laver Arena, Melbourne Olympic Park, and AAMI Park, then finishes with a guided Melbourne Cricket Ground tour. The published ticket includes MCG entry, cake, and tea rather than a laneway studio visit. The format suits visitors who want stadium context without a Great Ocean Road coach. Meeting points are confirmed at Federation Square in Melbourne, and the itinerary stays on those sports-precinct stops that define this outing rather than a Yarra Valley cellar door.

highlights: Rod Laver Arena and Olympic Park
AAMI Park soccer and rugby precinct
Birrarung Marr river walk from Federation Square

start.description: Meet at Federation Square, between Transport Bar and Princes Bridge, 1 Princes Walk, Melbourne VIC 3000, Australia. Look out for the tour guide playing with a tennis ball.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
